tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder should be individual Proprietorship Firm or Partnership Firm or Company Registered under Companies Act/ Partnership Act Registration certificate /SSI Certificate / License issued by the Commerce & Industries Department or any other Government statutory Authority.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Relevant document shall be uploaded

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder shall be a manufacturer of 11KV INDOOR CTs and should have minimum of 5 years experience in manufacturing, testing and supply of CTs & PTs as on date of bid submission.Purchase order/order completion certificates in respect of experience of minimum 5 years as manufacture shall be uploaded.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Relevant document shall be uploaded

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder should have manufacturing facility such as Plant & Machinery and testing equipments along with calibration status.The Bidders shall upload the copies of the Purchase bills/invoices of the machines and the list of Equipments which are installed in their factory premises.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Relevant document shall be uploaded

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder should have obtained orders from any Government Electrical Utilities/ PSUs /Any Govt. Factories for supply of not less than 80% of the tendered quantity required in any one of the last 3 year. (2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26). However it will be 40 % to Micro and Small Enterprises in any one of the last 2 years.Purchase Order copies placed by any Government Electrical Utilities/ PSUs /Any Govt. Factories shall be uploaded.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Relevant document shall be uploaded

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder should furnish following Type Test Certificates conducted as per IS 2705-1992 Standards at CPRI/ ERDA /NABL Accredited Government laboratories/NABL Accredited Government Testing Houses, to ascertain the quality of 11KV INDOOR CTs. The Type Test Report should not be older than 5 Years (for both indoor and outdoor CTs)a) Short Time Current Test(b) Temperature Rise Test c Lightning Impulse Voltage withstand Test (d)High Voltage Power Frequency wet withstand test (e)Determination of errors, Accuracies, Instrument security factor characteristics at all ratios according to the requirements appropriate designation or accuracy class(as per individual parts of IS 2705-1992.Type Test certificates issued from CPRI/ ERDA/ NABL Accredited Government laboratories /NABL Accredited Government Testing Houses shall be uploaded

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Relevant document shall be uploaded

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Average Annual Financial Turnover of the Tenderer should be not less than the amount put to tender during the last 3 preceding financial years (2022-23, 2023-24 & 2024-25). However, it will be 50% with respect to Micro and Small Enterprises in last 2 preceding financial yearsCertified copies of audited Financial statements such as P&L statement, Balance sheets for the FY (2022-23, 2023-24 & 2024-25) Shall be uploaded With UDIN.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Relevant document shall be uploaded
